examples.src: The meeting will take place on Friday.
examples.dst: 会议将在星期五举行。

examples.src: Great changes have taken place in my hometown.
examples.dst: 我的家乡发生了巨大的变化。

examples.src: When did the accident take place?
examples.dst: 这起事故是什么时候发生的？

confuse.diff: take place 指事情发生或举行；take part in 指参加活动。

examples.src: The beauty of the lake attracts many visitors.
examples.dst: 这个湖的美景吸引了许多游客。

examples.src: She was a great beauty in her youth.
examples.dst: 她年轻时是个大美人。

examples.src: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
examples.dst: 情人眼里出西施。

confuse.diff: beauty 是名词；beautiful 是形容词。

examples.src: The farmers had a good harvest this year.
examples.dst: 今年农民们喜获丰收。

examples.src: They harvest the wheat in July.
examples.dst: 他们在七月收割小麦。

examples.src: The harvest festival is held every autumn.
examples.dst: 丰收节每年秋天举行。

confuse.diff: harvest 指收获庄稼；reserve 指保留、预订。

examples.src: There was a big celebration after the match.
examples.dst: 比赛结束后举行了盛大的庆祝活动。

examples.src: The town held a celebration for its 100th birthday.
examples.dst: 小镇为建镇一百周年举行了庆祝活动。

examples.src: We had a party in celebration of her success.
examples.dst: 我们开了个聚会来庆祝她的成功。

confuse.diff: celebration 是名词；celebrate 是动词。

examples.src: The hunter followed the tracks into the forest.
examples.dst: 猎人循着足迹走进了森林。

examples.src: Early humans were hunters and gatherers.
examples.dst: 早期人类是狩猎者和采集者。

examples.src: He is a bargain hunter who loves sales.
examples.dst: 他是个爱淘便宜货的人，喜欢打折。

confuse.diff: hunter 是猎人；hunt 是打猎、搜寻的动作。

examples.src: Many animals starve during the long winter.
examples.dst: 许多动物在漫长的冬天里挨饿。

examples.src: I'm starving. Let's have dinner now.
examples.dst: 我饿坏了，咱们现在吃晚饭吧。

examples.src: The children were starved of love.
examples.dst: 这些孩子极度缺乏关爱。

confuse.diff: starve 是挨饿；starch 是淀粉。

examples.src: The origin of the festival is unclear.
examples.dst: 这个节日的起源并不清楚。

examples.src: This word is of Latin origin.
examples.dst: 这个词源于拉丁语。

examples.src: She is proud of her family origins.
examples.dst: 她为自己的家庭出身感到自豪。

confuse.diff: origin 是名词，指起源；original 多作形容词，指最初的、原创的。

examples.src: Christmas is a religious festival.
examples.dst: 圣诞节是一个宗教节日。

examples.src: He comes from a very religious family.
examples.dst: 他出身于一个非常虔诚的家庭。

examples.src: They held a religious ceremony in the church.
examples.dst: 他们在教堂里举行了宗教仪式。

confuse.diff: religious 是形容词；religion 是名词，指宗教。

means: 季节性的；随季节变化的

examples.src: Seasonal fruit is cheaper and fresher.
examples.dst: 应季水果更便宜也更新鲜。

examples.src: Many students find seasonal work in summer.
examples.dst: 许多学生在夏天找季节性的工作。

examples.src: There is a seasonal change in the weather here.
examples.dst: 这里的天气随季节变化。

confuse.diff: seasonal 是形容词；season 是名词，指季节。

examples.src: Our ancestors lived by farming and hunting.
examples.dst: 我们的祖先靠耕种和狩猎为生。

examples.src: People honour their ancestors during the festival.
examples.dst: 人们在节日里祭奠祖先。

examples.src: Birds are the descendants of dinosaur ancestors.
examples.dst: 鸟类是恐龙祖先的后代。

confuse.diff: ancestor 是祖先；ancient 是古代的。

means: 盂兰盆节（日本祭祖节日）

examples.src: Obon is a Japanese festival to honour ancestors.
examples.dst: 盂兰盆节是日本祭奠祖先的节日。

examples.src: Many people return home during Obon.
examples.dst: 许多人在盂兰盆节期间回家。

examples.src: They dance in the street at Obon.
examples.dst: 他们在盂兰盆节时在街上跳舞。

examples.src: They placed flowers on his grave.
examples.dst: 他们在他的墓前放上了鲜花。

examples.src: The doctor looked grave when he read the report.
examples.dst: 医生看报告时神情严肃。

examples.src: This is a grave mistake.
examples.dst: 这是一个严重的错误。

confuse.diff: grave 是坟墓或严重的；gravity 是重力、严重性。

examples.src: They burned incense in front of the statue.
examples.dst: 他们在雕像前焚香。

examples.src: The room was full of the smell of incense.
examples.dst: 房间里满是香的气味。

examples.src: She lit a stick of incense for her ancestors.
examples.dst: 她为祖先点了一炷香。

confuse.diff: incense 是香；incentive 是激励、动力。

examples.src: A statue was built in memory of the hero.
examples.dst: 为纪念这位英雄建了一座雕像。

examples.src: We stood in silence in memory of the victims.
examples.dst: 我们静默以悼念遇难者。

examples.src: The scholarship was set up in memory of her father.
examples.dst: 这笔奖学金是为纪念她的父亲而设立的。

confuse.diff: in memory of 强调缅怀逝者；in honour of 强调向某人表示敬意。

examples.src: They prepared a feast for the guests.
examples.dst: 他们为客人准备了一桌盛宴。

examples.src: The wedding feast lasted for hours.
examples.dst: 婚宴持续了好几个小时。

examples.src: The children feasted on cakes and sweets.
examples.dst: 孩子们尽情吃着蛋糕和糖果。

confuse.diff: feast 是盛宴；fist 是拳头。

examples.src: The scientists found a human skull in the cave.
examples.dst: 科学家在洞穴里发现了一块人类头骨。

examples.src: A skull protects the brain.
examples.dst: 颅骨保护大脑。

examples.src: The pirate flag has a skull on it.
examples.dst: 海盗旗上有一个骷髅头。

confuse.diff: skull 是头骨；scull 是短桨或划桨。

examples.src: He broke a bone in his leg.
examples.dst: 他的腿骨折了。

examples.src: The dog is chewing a bone.
examples.dst: 狗正在啃骨头。

examples.src: Milk helps build strong bones.
examples.dst: 牛奶有助于骨骼强健。

confuse.diff: bone 是骨头；born 是出生的。

examples.src: Children wear costumes on Halloween.
examples.dst: 孩子们在万圣节穿上奇装异服。

examples.src: We carved a pumpkin for Halloween.
examples.dst: 我们为万圣节雕刻了一个南瓜灯。

examples.src: Halloween is celebrated on October 31st.
examples.dst: 万圣节在十月三十一日庆祝。

examples.src: It is my belief that hard work pays off.
examples.dst: 我相信努力会有回报。

examples.src: They have different religious beliefs.
examples.dst: 他们有不同的宗教信仰。

examples.src: There is a widespread belief that cats have nine lives.
examples.dst: 有一种普遍的说法是猫有九条命。

confuse.diff: belief 是名词；believe 是动词。

examples.src: We dressed up for the party.
examples.dst: 我们为聚会盛装打扮。

examples.src: The children dressed up as ghosts.
examples.dst: 孩子们装扮成了鬼怪。

examples.src: You don't need to dress up for dinner.
examples.dst: 吃晚饭不需要穿得太正式。

confuse.diff: dress up 指打扮或化装；put on 指穿上某件衣服。

examples.src: The magician showed us a clever trick.
examples.dst: 魔术师给我们表演了一个巧妙的戏法。

examples.src: He played a trick on his sister.
examples.dst: 他捉弄了他的姐姐。

examples.src: They tricked me into signing the paper.
examples.dst: 他们骗我在文件上签了字。

confuse.diff: trick 是诡计、把戏；track 是轨道、足迹。

examples.src: The boys played a trick on their teacher.
examples.dst: 男孩们捉弄了他们的老师。

examples.src: Don't play tricks on your little brother.
examples.dst: 别捉弄你的小弟弟。

examples.src: She likes to play a trick on her friends on April Fools' Day.
examples.dst: 她喜欢在愚人节捉弄朋友。

confuse.diff: 两者意思接近，play a trick on 更强调使人上当的把戏。

examples.src: Li Bai is a famous Chinese poet.
examples.dst: 李白是中国著名的诗人。

examples.src: The poet read his new poem aloud.
examples.dst: 诗人大声朗读了他的新诗。

examples.src: She dreamed of becoming a poet.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名诗人。

confuse.diff: poet 是诗人；poem 是诗。

examples.src: Columbus Day is observed in October in the US.
examples.dst: 美国在十月纪念哥伦布日。

examples.src: Schools are closed on Columbus Day.
examples.dst: 哥伦布日那天学校放假。

examples.src: Columbus Day marks his arrival in the Americas.
examples.dst: 哥伦布日纪念他抵达美洲大陆。

examples.src: We were waiting for the arrival of the train.
examples.dst: 我们在等火车到站。

examples.src: The arrival of spring brings new life.
examples.dst: 春天的到来带来了新的生机。

examples.src: Please check the arrival time of your flight.
examples.dst: 请核对你航班的到达时间。

confuse.diff: arrival 是名词；arrive 是动词。

examples.src: He gained a lot of experience from the job.
examples.dst: 他从这份工作中获得了很多经验。

examples.src: I have gained three kilos this month.
examples.dst: 这个月我胖了三公斤。

examples.src: Hard work brings both pain and gain.
examples.dst: 努力工作既有辛苦也有收获。

confuse.diff: gain 是获得；gait 是步态。

examples.src: The country won its independence in 1947.
examples.dst: 这个国家于1947年获得独立。

examples.src: Teenagers want more independence from their parents.
examples.dst: 青少年希望更多地摆脱父母的管束。

examples.src: Financial independence is important for young people.
examples.dst: 经济独立对年轻人很重要。

confuse.diff: independence 是名词；independent 是形容词。

examples.src: She is an independent young woman.
examples.dst: 她是一位独立的年轻女性。

examples.src: The island became an independent country.
examples.dst: 这个岛成为了一个独立的国家。

examples.src: Students should learn to be independent.
examples.dst: 学生应该学会独立。

confuse.diff: independent 是形容词；independence 是名词。

examples.src: Crowds gathered in the square to watch the parade.
examples.dst: 人群聚集在广场上观看游行。

examples.src: We gathered some wild flowers on the hill.
examples.dst: 我们在山上采了一些野花。

examples.src: I gather that he has already left.
examples.dst: 我推测他已经离开了。

confuse.diff: gather 是聚集、收集；gain 是获得、增加。

examples.src: Agriculture is the basis of the economy here.
examples.dst: 农业是这里经济的基础。

examples.src: Modern agriculture uses a lot of machines.
examples.dst: 现代农业使用大量机械。

examples.src: He studies agriculture at university.
examples.dst: 他在大学学习农学。

confuse.diff: agriculture 是名词；agricultural 是形容词。

examples.src: China is a large agricultural country.
examples.dst: 中国是一个农业大国。

examples.src: Agricultural products are sold in the market.
examples.dst: 农产品在市场上出售。

examples.src: The village has a lot of agricultural land.
examples.dst: 这个村子有大量农业用地。

confuse.diff: agricultural 是形容词；agriculture 是名词。

examples.src: She won an award for best actress.
examples.dst: 她获得了最佳女演员奖。

examples.src: The school awarded him a scholarship.
examples.dst: 学校授予他一笔奖学金。

examples.src: The award ceremony will be held tonight.
examples.dst: 颁奖典礼将于今晚举行。

confuse.diff: award 指因成就而颁发的奖项；reward 指酬谢或奖赏。

examples.src: The factory produces thousands of cars a year.
examples.dst: 这家工厂每年生产数千辆汽车。

examples.src: Cows produce milk.
examples.dst: 奶牛产奶。

examples.src: The shop sells fresh farm produce.
examples.dst: 这家店出售新鲜的农产品。

confuse.diff: produce 是动词，也指农产品；product 是名词，指产品。

examples.src: The rooster crows at dawn.
examples.dst: 公鸡在黎明时啼叫。

examples.src: A rooster stood on the fence.
examples.dst: 一只公鸡站在栅栏上。

examples.src: The year of the Rooster is a Chinese zodiac year.
examples.dst: 鸡年是中国生肖年之一。

confuse.diff: rooster 是公鸡；roost 是栖息处或栖息。

examples.src: I admire her courage.
examples.dst: 我钦佩她的勇气。

examples.src: We stood on the hill and admired the view.
examples.dst: 我们站在山上欣赏景色。

examples.src: Everyone admires him for his honesty.
examples.dst: 大家都因他的诚实而敬佩他。

confuse.diff: admire 是钦佩；admit 是承认、准许进入。

means: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

examples.src: The children are energetic and full of fun.
examples.dst: 孩子们精力充沛，充满乐趣。

examples.src: He gave an energetic speech.
examples.dst: 他发表了一场充满活力的演讲。

examples.src: Despite his age, he is still very energetic.
examples.dst: 尽管上了年纪，他依然精力充沛。

confuse.diff: energetic 是形容词；energy 是名词，指能量、精力。

examples.src: I look forward to hearing from you.
examples.dst: 我期待收到你的来信。

examples.src: The students are looking forward to the summer holiday.
examples.dst: 学生们都在盼望暑假。

examples.src: We look forward to meeting you next week.
examples.dst: 我们期待下周与你见面。

confuse.diff: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词；look forward 单独是向前看。

examples.src: The carnival in Rio attracts millions of visitors.
examples.dst: 里约的狂欢节吸引了数百万游客。

examples.src: There was a carnival in the town last weekend.
examples.dst: 上周末镇上举办了一场嘉年华。

examples.src: People wear colourful costumes at the carnival.
examples.dst: 人们在狂欢节上穿着色彩鲜艳的服装。

confuse.diff: carnival 是狂欢节；carbon 是碳。

examples.src: The Spring Festival falls on the first day of the lunar year.
examples.dst: 春节在农历新年的第一天。

examples.src: A lunar eclipse happened last night.
examples.dst: 昨晚发生了月食。

examples.src: The lunar calendar is based on the moon.
examples.dst: 阴历是以月亮为依据的历法。

confuse.diff: lunar 指月亮的；solar 指太阳的。

examples.src: Children hunt for eggs at Easter.
examples.dst: 孩子们在复活节找彩蛋。

examples.src: Easter is an important Christian festival.
examples.dst: 复活节是基督教的重要节日。

examples.src: We will visit my grandparents at Easter.
examples.dst: 复活节我们将去看望祖父母。

confuse.diff: Easter 是复活节；east 是东方。

examples.src: We watched the National Day parade on TV.
examples.dst: 我们在电视上观看了国庆阅兵。

examples.src: Thousands of people paraded through the streets.
examples.dst: 成千上万的人在街上游行。

examples.src: The carnival parade was colourful.
examples.dst: 狂欢节的游行色彩缤纷。

confuse.diff: parade 是游行；parent 是父母。

examples.src: The doctors worked day and night to save lives.
examples.dst: 医生们日夜工作以挽救生命。

examples.src: The shop is open day and night.
examples.dst: 这家商店昼夜营业。

examples.src: She studied day and night for the exam.
examples.dst: 她为准备考试日夜苦读。

confuse.diff: day and night 指昼夜不停；day by day 指一天天地逐渐。

examples.src: Warm clothing is necessary in winter.
examples.dst: 冬天需要穿保暖的衣物。

examples.src: The shop sells children's clothing.
examples.dst: 这家店出售童装。

examples.src: Food, clothing and shelter are basic needs.
examples.dst: 衣食住是基本需求。

confuse.diff: clothing 是衣物的总称，不可数；cloth 是布料。

examples.src: She is a devout Christian.
examples.dst: 她是一名虔诚的基督徒。

examples.src: Christmas is a Christian festival.
examples.dst: 圣诞节是基督教的节日。

examples.src: Many Christians go to church on Sunday.
examples.dst: 许多基督徒星期天去教堂。

confuse.diff: Christian 是基督徒或基督教的；Christmas 是圣诞节。

examples.src: She put a cherry on top of the cake.
examples.dst: 她在蛋糕顶上放了一颗樱桃。

examples.src: The cherry trees bloom in spring.
examples.dst: 樱桃树在春天开花。

examples.src: These cherries taste sweet.
examples.dst: 这些樱桃尝起来很甜。

confuse.diff: cherry 是樱桃；cheery 是兴高采烈的。

examples.src: The cherry blossoms are beautiful in April.
examples.dst: 四月的樱花很美。

examples.src: The apple trees blossom in spring.
examples.dst: 苹果树在春天开花。

examples.src: She blossomed into a confident young woman.
examples.dst: 她成长为一位自信的年轻女性。

confuse.diff: blossom 多指果树等的花簇；bloom 泛指花朵或开花。

examples.src: He talks as though he knew everything.
examples.dst: 他说话好像什么都知道。

examples.src: It looks as though it is going to rain.
examples.dst: 看起来好像要下雨了。

examples.src: She acted as though nothing had happened.
examples.dst: 她表现得好像什么事都没发生过。

confuse.diff: as though 表示好像；even though 表示即使、尽管。

examples.src: The kids have fun with the new toys.
examples.dst: 孩子们玩新玩具玩得很开心。

examples.src: We had fun with our friends at the beach.
examples.dst: 我们和朋友们在海滩上玩得很开心。

examples.src: Let's have fun with this game.
examples.dst: 让我们开心地玩这个游戏吧。

confuse.diff: have fun with 是和…玩得开心；make fun of 是嘲笑。

examples.src: It is a local custom to eat dumplings on that day.
examples.dst: 那天吃饺子是当地的习俗。

examples.src: Different countries have different customs.
examples.dst: 不同国家有不同的风俗。

examples.src: It is his custom to walk after dinner.
examples.dst: 饭后散步是他的习惯。

confuse.diff: custom 是习俗；costume 是服装、戏服。

examples.src: The singer has worldwide fame.
examples.dst: 这位歌手享誉全球。

examples.src: The film was released worldwide.
examples.dst: 这部电影在全球上映。

examples.src: Football is popular worldwide.
examples.dst: 足球在全世界都很受欢迎。

confuse.diff: worldwide 指遍及世界的；world-famous 指世界闻名的。

examples.src: A red rosebud was about to open.
examples.dst: 一朵红色的玫瑰花蕾即将绽放。

examples.src: She wore a rosebud in her hair.
examples.dst: 她头上戴着一朵玫瑰花蕾。

examples.src: The garden was full of rosebuds in May.
examples.dst: 五月时花园里满是玫瑰花蕾。

examples.src: Don't be a fool. Think before you act.
examples.dst: 别犯傻，三思而后行。

examples.src: He made a fool of himself at the party.
examples.dst: 他在聚会上出了丑。

examples.src: They fooled me with a fake email.
examples.dst: 他们用一封假邮件骗了我。

confuse.diff: fool 是傻瓜；food 是食物。

examples.src: Water is a necessity of life.
examples.dst: 水是生活必需品。

examples.src: There is no necessity to hurry.
examples.dst: 没有必要匆忙。

examples.src: Food and shelter are basic necessities.
examples.dst: 食物和住所是基本的生活必需品。

confuse.diff: necessity 是名词；necessary 是形容词。

examples.src: You need your parents' permission to go.
examples.dst: 你去需要得到父母的许可。

examples.src: He asked for permission to leave early.
examples.dst: 他请求准许提前离开。

examples.src: Photography is not allowed without permission.
examples.dst: 未经许可不得拍照。

confuse.diff: permission 是名词，指允许；permit 是动词，指允许，也作名词指许可证。

examples.src: His prediction about the weather was right.
examples.dst: 他对天气的预测是准确的。

examples.src: It is hard to make an accurate prediction.
examples.dst: 很难做出准确的预测。

examples.src: Scientists made a prediction about climate change.
examples.dst: 科学家们对气候变化做出了预测。

confuse.diff: prediction 是名词；predict 是动词。

examples.src: Short skirts are in fashion this year.
examples.dst: 今年流行短裙。

examples.src: She studies fashion design.
examples.dst: 她学习服装设计。

examples.src: He does things in his own fashion.
examples.dst: 他按自己的方式做事。

confuse.diff: fashion 是名词；fashionable 是形容词，指时髦的。

means: 特立尼达（加勒比海岛屿）

examples.src: Trinidad is famous for its carnival.
examples.dst: 特立尼达以狂欢节闻名。

examples.src: They spent their holiday in Trinidad.
examples.dst: 他们在特立尼达度假。

examples.src: Trinidad lies in the Caribbean Sea.
examples.dst: 特立尼达位于加勒比海。

examples.src: There is no parking on this street.
examples.dst: 这条街禁止停车。

examples.src: Parking is free on Sundays.
examples.dst: 周日停车免费。

examples.src: It's hard to find parking downtown.
examples.dst: 市中心很难找到停车位。

confuse.diff: parking 是停车；packing 是打包。

examples.src: The parking lot is behind the mall.
examples.dst: 停车场在商场后面。

examples.src: I left my car in the parking lot.
examples.dst: 我把车停在了停车场。

examples.src: The parking lot was full on Saturday.
examples.dst: 周六停车场停满了车。

confuse.diff: parking lot 指停车的场地；parking 指停车这一行为或车位。

examples.src: He sent her flowers on Valentine's Day.
examples.dst: 他在情人节那天送给她鲜花。

examples.src: Valentine's Day is on February 14th.
examples.dst: 情人节在二月十四日。

examples.src: They had dinner together on Valentine's Day.
examples.dst: 他们在情人节一起吃了晚饭。

examples.src: He didn't turn up at the meeting.
examples.dst: 他没有出席会议。

examples.src: Could you turn up the volume, please?
examples.dst: 请把音量开大一点好吗？

examples.src: My lost keys turned up under the sofa.
examples.dst: 我丢的钥匙在沙发下找到了。

confuse.diff: turn up 是开大或出现；turn down 是调小或拒绝。

examples.src: He always keeps his word.
examples.dst: 他总是信守诺言。

examples.src: A good friend keeps her word.
examples.dst: 好朋友会信守承诺。

examples.src: I promise to keep my word this time.
examples.dst: 我保证这次说话算数。

confuse.diff: keep one's word 是守信；keep in mind 是记住。

examples.src: He held his breath and dived under the water.
examples.dst: 他屏住呼吸潜入水中。

examples.src: We held our breath as the results were announced.
examples.dst: 宣布结果时我们屏住了呼吸。

examples.src: Hold your breath for ten seconds.
examples.dst: 屏住呼吸十秒钟。

confuse.diff: hold one's breath 是屏息；take a breath 是吸一口气。

examples.src: I apologize for being late.
examples.dst: 我为迟到道歉。

examples.src: He apologized to her for his rude words.
examples.dst: 他为自己无礼的话向她道歉。

examples.src: You should apologize to your teacher.
examples.dst: 你应该向老师道歉。

confuse.diff: apologize 是动词；apology 是名词，指道歉。

examples.src: The boy nearly drowned in the river.
examples.dst: 那个男孩差点在河里淹死。

examples.src: The loud music drowned out his voice.
examples.dst: 响亮的音乐声淹没了他的声音。

examples.src: Many villages were drowned by the flood.
examples.dst: 许多村庄被洪水淹没。

confuse.diff: drown 是淹死；drawn 是 draw 的过去分词，意为画、拉。

examples.src: She felt deep sadness when her friend left.
examples.dst: 朋友离开时她感到深深的悲伤。

examples.src: There was sadness in his voice.
examples.dst: 他的声音里透着悲伤。

examples.src: The news filled us with sadness.
examples.dst: 这个消息让我们倍感悲伤。

confuse.diff: sadness 是名词；sad 是形容词。

examples.src: It was obvious that he was tired.
examples.dst: 很明显他累了。

examples.src: The answer is obvious to everyone.
examples.dst: 这个答案对每个人来说都显而易见。

examples.src: There is an obvious difference between the two.
examples.dst: 这两者之间有明显的差别。

confuse.diff: obvious 是形容词；obviously 是副词。

examples.src: She wiped the table with a cloth.
examples.dst: 她用布擦了桌子。

examples.src: He wiped the tears from his face.
examples.dst: 他擦去脸上的泪水。

examples.src: Please wipe your feet before you come in.
examples.dst: 进来之前请擦一下脚。

confuse.diff: wipe 是擦；wife 是妻子。

examples.src: She weaves baskets from bamboo.
examples.dst: 她用竹子编篮子。

examples.src: The cloth was woven by hand.
examples.dst: 这块布是手工织成的。

examples.src: The writer wove a story around a true event.
examples.dst: 作家围绕一件真实事件编了一个故事。

confuse.diff: weave 是编织；wave 是挥手或波浪。

examples.src: A herd of cows was crossing the road.
examples.dst: 一群奶牛正在过马路。

examples.src: The boy herded the sheep into the field.
examples.dst: 男孩把羊赶进了田里。

examples.src: We saw a herd of elephants in the park.
examples.dst: 我们在公园里看见了一群大象。

confuse.diff: herd 是兽群；heard 是 hear 的过去式，意为听见。

examples.src: We can see the Milky Way on a clear night.
examples.dst: 晴朗的夜晚我们能看见银河。

examples.src: The Milky Way contains billions of stars.
examples.dst: 银河系包含数十亿颗恒星。

examples.src: The Earth belongs to the Milky Way.
examples.dst: 地球属于银河系。

examples.src: A magpie was singing in the tree.
examples.dst: 一只喜鹊在树上鸣叫。

examples.src: In Chinese culture, magpies bring good luck.
examples.dst: 在中国文化中，喜鹊带来好运。

examples.src: Magpies build their nests high in the trees.
examples.dst: 喜鹊把巢筑在高高的树上。

examples.src: She wept when she heard the sad news.
examples.dst: 听到这个坏消息，她哭了。

examples.src: The child wept for his lost dog.
examples.dst: 孩子为走失的小狗而哭泣。

examples.src: He wept with joy at the reunion.
examples.dst: 重逢时他喜极而泣。

confuse.diff: weep 是哭泣；week 是星期。

examples.src: The announcer read the evening news.
examples.dst: 播音员播报了晚间新闻。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a radio announcer.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名电台播音员。

examples.src: The announcer said the train was late.
examples.dst: 播音员说火车晚点了。

confuse.diff: announcer 是播音员；announce 是宣布。

examples.src: We set off for Beijing at dawn.
examples.dst: 我们黎明时动身去北京。

examples.src: The children set off fireworks at night.
examples.dst: 孩子们夜里燃放烟花。

examples.src: Smoke set off the alarm.
examples.dst: 烟雾触发了警报。

confuse.diff: set off 与 set out 都可表示出发；set out 还可表示着手做某事。

examples.src: Please remind me to call him.
examples.dst: 请提醒我给他打电话。

examples.src: This song reminds me of my childhood.
examples.dst: 这首歌让我想起了童年。

examples.src: She reminded him of his promise.
examples.dst: 她提醒他别忘了自己的承诺。

confuse.diff: remind 是提醒别人；remember 是自己记得。

examples.src: She reminds me of my mother.
examples.dst: 她让我想起了我的母亲。

examples.src: The photo reminded him of his school days.
examples.dst: 这张照片让他想起了学生时代。

examples.src: Remind me of the meeting tomorrow.
examples.dst: 提醒我明天有会议。

confuse.diff: remind…of… 后接名词；remind sb. to do 后接动词不定式，提醒做某事。

examples.src: Please forgive me for being late.
examples.dst: 请原谅我迟到了。

examples.src: She forgave him for his mistake.
examples.dst: 她原谅了他的过错。

examples.src: It is hard to forgive someone who lied to you.
examples.dst: 很难原谅欺骗过你的人。

confuse.diff: forgive 是原谅；forget 是忘记。

examples.src: A healthy diet includes plenty of vegetables.
examples.dst: 健康的饮食包括大量蔬菜。

examples.src: She is on a diet to lose weight.
examples.dst: 她正在节食减肥。

examples.src: He has to diet because of his health.
examples.dst: 由于健康原因，他必须节食。

confuse.diff: diet 是饮食；die 是死亡。

examples.src: We had spaghetti for dinner.
examples.dst: 我们晚饭吃了意大利面。

examples.src: He cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce.
examples.dst: 他做了番茄酱意面。

examples.src: Spaghetti is popular all over the world.
examples.dst: 意大利面在全世界都很受欢迎。

examples.src: Squirrels collect nuts for the winter.
examples.dst: 松鼠为过冬收集坚果。

examples.src: He is allergic to nuts.
examples.dst: 他对坚果过敏。

examples.src: Tighten the nut with a wrench.
examples.dst: 用扳手把螺母拧紧。

confuse.diff: nut 是坚果；not 是否定词“不”。

examples.src: Regular exercise builds strong muscles.
examples.dst: 经常锻炼能增强肌肉。

examples.src: He pulled a muscle in his leg.
examples.dst: 他的腿部肌肉拉伤了。

examples.src: Protein helps muscles grow.
examples.dst: 蛋白质有助于肌肉生长。

confuse.diff: muscle 是肌肉；mussel 是贻贝。

examples.src: Wear protective clothing in the lab.
examples.dst: 在实验室要穿防护服。

examples.src: She is very protective of her little brother.
examples.dst: 她非常保护自己的弟弟。

examples.src: Fruit skin has a protective effect.
examples.dst: 果皮具有保护作用。

confuse.diff: protective 是形容词；protect 是动词，意为保护。

examples.src: We had green beans with dinner.
examples.dst: 我们晚饭吃了四季豆。

examples.src: Soya beans are rich in protein.
examples.dst: 大豆富含蛋白质。

examples.src: She grinds coffee beans every morning.
examples.dst: 她每天早上磨咖啡豆。

confuse.diff: bean 是豆子；been 是 be 的过去分词。

examples.src: The soup is made with green peas.
examples.dst: 这道汤是用青豌豆做的。

examples.src: Peas grow in pods.
examples.dst: 豌豆长在豆荚里。

examples.src: He doesn't like peas.
examples.dst: 他不喜欢吃豌豆。

confuse.diff: pea 是豌豆；pee 是小便（口语）。

examples.src: She sliced a cucumber for the salad.
examples.dst: 她切了一根黄瓜做沙拉。

examples.src: Cucumbers contain a lot of water.
examples.dst: 黄瓜含有大量水分。

examples.src: I put cucumber on my sandwich.
examples.dst: 我在三明治里放了黄瓜。

examples.src: Grandma cooked eggplant with garlic.
examples.dst: 奶奶用大蒜烧了茄子。

examples.src: The eggplant has smooth purple skin.
examples.dst: 茄子有光滑的紫色外皮。

examples.src: Eggplant is a popular vegetable in China.
examples.dst: 茄子在中国是常见的蔬菜。

examples.src: Add some salt and pepper to the soup.
examples.dst: 往汤里加点盐和胡椒粉。

examples.src: She stir-fried green peppers.
examples.dst: 她炒了青椒。

examples.src: This red pepper is very hot.
examples.dst: 这个红辣椒非常辣。

confuse.diff: pepper 是胡椒或辣椒；paper 是纸。

examples.src: We picked mushrooms in the forest.
examples.dst: 我们在森林里采蘑菇。

examples.src: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous.
examples.dst: 有些野蘑菇有毒。

examples.src: Fast-food shops have mushroomed in the city.
examples.dst: 快餐店在这座城市里迅速增多。

examples.src: The peach is juicy and sweet.
examples.dst: 这个桃子多汁又甜。

examples.src: Peach trees bloom in spring.
examples.dst: 桃树在春天开花。

examples.src: She bought a kilo of peaches.
examples.dst: 她买了一公斤桃子。

confuse.diff: peach 是桃子；beach 是海滩。

examples.src: Squeeze some lemon juice into the tea.
examples.dst: 往茶里挤点柠檬汁。

examples.src: Lemons taste sour.
examples.dst: 柠檬味道很酸。

examples.src: She added a slice of lemon to the water.
examples.dst: 她往水里加了一片柠檬。

confuse.diff: lemon 是柠檬；lemonade 是柠檬水。

examples.src: He lost his balance and fell off the bike.
examples.dst: 他失去平衡，从自行车上摔了下来。

examples.src: Students should balance study and rest.
examples.dst: 学生应当平衡学习与休息。

examples.src: Please check your bank balance.
examples.dst: 请查看你的银行账户余额。

confuse.diff: balance 是名词或动词；balanced 是形容词，意为均衡的。

examples.src: A balanced diet keeps you healthy.
examples.dst: 均衡饮食使你保持健康。

examples.src: Teenagers need a balanced diet to grow.
examples.dst: 青少年需要均衡饮食来生长发育。

examples.src: A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables and protein.
examples.dst: 均衡饮食包括水果、蔬菜和蛋白质。

examples.src: We had a barbecue in the garden.
examples.dst: 我们在花园里搞了一次烧烤。

examples.src: He barbecued some chicken wings.
examples.dst: 他烤了一些鸡翅。

examples.src: The barbecue smelled wonderful.
examples.dst: 烧烤的味道很香。

examples.src: Mutton is popular in winter.
examples.dst: 冬天羊肉很受欢迎。

examples.src: We had roast mutton for dinner.
examples.dst: 我们晚饭吃了烤羊肉。

examples.src: He doesn't like the smell of mutton.
examples.dst: 他不喜欢羊肉的味道。

confuse.diff: mutton 是羊肉；button 是纽扣。

examples.src: He bought a lamb kebab from the street stall.
examples.dst: 他在街边摊买了一串羊肉串。

examples.src: Kebabs are cooked over charcoal.
examples.dst: 烤肉串是用炭火烤的。

examples.src: We ordered chicken kebabs.
examples.dst: 我们点了鸡肉串。

examples.src: She roasted a chicken for dinner.
examples.dst: 她烤了一只鸡当晚饭。

examples.src: We roasted sweet potatoes over the fire.
examples.dst: 我们在火上烤红薯。

examples.src: Sunday roast is a British tradition.
examples.dst: 周日烤肉是英国的传统。

confuse.diff: roast 是烤肉类等；toast 是烤面包片或祝酒。

examples.src: Stir the soup with a spoon.
examples.dst: 用勺子搅一搅汤。

examples.src: The news stirred up strong feelings.
examples.dst: 这个消息激起了强烈的情绪。

examples.src: Her speech caused a stir.
examples.dst: 她的演讲引起了轰动。

confuse.diff: stir 是搅拌；star 是星星。

examples.src: Fry the eggs in a little oil.
examples.dst: 用少量油煎鸡蛋。

examples.src: Mum is frying fish in the kitchen.
examples.dst: 妈妈正在厨房里煎鱼。

examples.src: Fried food is not healthy.
examples.dst: 油炸食品不健康。

confuse.diff: fry 是煎炸；fly 是飞。

examples.src: Stir-fry the vegetables for two minutes.
examples.dst: 把蔬菜快炒两分钟。

examples.src: He made a beef stir-fry for lunch.
examples.dst: 他中午做了一道炒牛肉。

examples.src: Chinese people often stir-fry vegetables.
examples.dst: 中国人常常炒蔬菜。

confuse.diff: stir-fry 指不断翻动的快炒；fry 泛指煎或炸。

examples.src: You ought to apologize to her.
examples.dst: 你应该向她道歉。

examples.src: We ought to leave now.
examples.dst: 我们该走了。

examples.src: He ought not to drive so fast.
examples.dst: 他不该开这么快。

confuse.diff: ought 是应该；aught 是古语“任何事物”，很少用。

examples.src: Students ought to respect their teachers.
examples.dst: 学生应该尊敬老师。

examples.src: You ought to see a doctor.
examples.dst: 你应该去看医生。

examples.src: The meeting ought to be over by now.
examples.dst: 会议现在应该已经结束了。

confuse.diff: ought to 表示应该；have to 表示不得不。

examples.src: He had bacon and eggs for breakfast.
examples.dst: 他早餐吃了培根和鸡蛋。

examples.src: The smell of bacon filled the kitchen.
examples.dst: 厨房里充满了培根的香味。

examples.src: She added bacon to the pasta.
examples.dst: 她往意面里加了培根。

examples.src: He ordered a glass of cola.
examples.dst: 他点了一杯可乐。

examples.src: Too much cola is bad for your teeth.
examples.dst: 喝太多可乐对牙齿不好。

examples.src: She poured cola into the cups.
examples.dst: 她把可乐倒进杯子里。

confuse.diff: cola 是可乐；coal 是煤。

examples.src: Avoid sugary drinks if you want to stay healthy.
examples.dst: 想保持健康就要少喝含糖饮料。

examples.src: Sugary snacks are bad for your teeth.
examples.dst: 含糖零食对牙齿不好。

examples.src: The tea was too sugary for me.
examples.dst: 这茶对我来说太甜了。

confuse.diff: sugary 是形容词；sugar 是名词，意为糖。

examples.src: The sign says No Parking.
examples.dst: 标志上写着禁止停车。

examples.src: Dark clouds are a sign of rain.
examples.dst: 乌云是下雨的征兆。

examples.src: Please sign your name here.
examples.dst: 请在这里签名。

confuse.diff: sign 是标志或签名；sing 是唱歌。

examples.src: She is trying to lose weight.
examples.dst: 她正在努力减肥。

examples.src: He lost five kilos in two months.
examples.dst: 他两个月瘦了五公斤。

examples.src: Running is a good way to lose weight.
examples.dst: 跑步是减肥的好办法。

confuse.diff: lose weight 是固定搭配；lose 单独指丢失或输掉。

examples.src: She has a slim figure.
examples.dst: 她身材苗条。

examples.src: There is only a slim chance of success.
examples.dst: 成功的机会很渺茫。

examples.src: He is slimming for the summer.
examples.dst: 他为了夏天正在减肥。

confuse.diff: slim 是苗条的；slime 是黏液。

examples.src: Children are full of curiosity.
examples.dst: 孩子们充满好奇心。

examples.src: Curiosity led her to open the box.
examples.dst: 好奇心驱使她打开了盒子。

examples.src: Out of curiosity, he asked how much it cost.
examples.dst: 出于好奇，他问了价格。

confuse.diff: curiosity 是名词；curious 是形容词。

examples.src: The hostess welcomed the guests at the door.
examples.dst: 女主人在门口迎接客人。

examples.src: She thanked the hostess for the lovely dinner.
examples.dst: 她感谢女主人的美味晚餐。

examples.src: The hostess of the show is very popular.
examples.dst: 这档节目的女主持人很受欢迎。

confuse.diff: hostess 指女主人；host 指男主人或泛指主人。

examples.src: Don't eat raw meat.
examples.dst: 不要吃生肉。

examples.src: Cotton is a raw material for clothes.
examples.dst: 棉花是做衣服的原材料。

examples.src: She likes raw carrots.
examples.dst: 她喜欢吃生胡萝卜。

confuse.diff: raw 是生的；row 是一排或划船。

examples.src: Add a little vinegar to the salad.
examples.dst: 往沙拉里加一点醋。

examples.src: Vinegar tastes sour.
examples.dst: 醋的味道是酸的。

examples.src: Shanxi is famous for its vinegar.
examples.dst: 山西以醋闻名。

means: 侥幸逃脱惩罚；做坏事而未受惩罚

examples.src: He cheated but got away with it.
examples.dst: 他作了弊却没被发现。

examples.src: You won't get away with lying to me.
examples.dst: 你骗我是不会逍遥法外的。

examples.src: They got away with breaking the rule.
examples.dst: 他们违反了规定却没受罚。

confuse.diff: get away with 指逃脱惩罚；get away from 指离开某处。

examples.src: Don't tell lies to your parents.
examples.dst: 不要对父母撒谎。

examples.src: He lied about his age.
examples.dst: 他谎报了年龄。

examples.src: The village lies at the foot of the hill.
examples.dst: 村庄坐落在山脚下。

confuse.diff: lie 是躺或说谎；lay 是放置或下蛋。

examples.src: A good child never tells a lie.
examples.dst: 好孩子从不撒谎。

examples.src: He told a lie to avoid trouble.
examples.dst: 他为了避免麻烦而撒了谎。

examples.src: It is wrong to tell a lie.
examples.dst: 撒谎是不对的。

confuse.diff: tell a lie 是说谎；tell the truth 是说实话。

examples.src: The shop has many regular customers.
examples.dst: 这家店有很多老顾客。

examples.src: The customer is always right.
examples.dst: 顾客永远是对的。

examples.src: She helped a customer find a gift.
examples.dst: 她帮一位顾客挑选礼物。

confuse.diff: customer 是顾客；costume 是服装。

examples.src: Students get a 20% discount here.
examples.dst: 学生在这里可享受八折优惠。

examples.src: The shop is discounting winter coats.
examples.dst: 这家店在给冬装打折。

examples.src: Can you give me a discount?
examples.dst: 能给我打个折吗？

confuse.diff: discount 是折扣；discover 是发现。

examples.src: The team won back the title this year.
examples.dst: 这支队伍今年夺回了冠军。

examples.src: He tried to win back her trust.
examples.dst: 他努力赢回她的信任。

examples.src: The shop offered discounts to win customers back.
examples.dst: 这家店用折扣来挽回顾客。

confuse.diff: win…back 是赢回；win over 是争取、说服。

examples.src: Everyone has strengths and weaknesses.
examples.dst: 每个人都有优点和缺点。

examples.dst: 她在决定之前征求了父母的意见。

examples.dst: 纤维有助于消化。

examples.src: Rabbits love carrots.
examples.dst: 兔子喜欢吃胡萝卜。

examples.src: Carrots are good for your eyes.
examples.dst: 胡萝卜对眼睛有益。

examples.dst: 她擦了一根胡萝卜做沙拉。

confuse.diff: carrot 是胡萝卜；carat 是克拉。

examples.dst: 缺乏维生素 C 会导致坏血病。

examples.dst: 橙子可以预防坏血病。

examples.dst: 缺乏维生素 D 会引起佝偻病。

examples.dst: 患佝偻病的儿童骨骼脆弱。

examples.dst: 如今佝偻病在富裕国家已很少见。

confuse.diff: rickets 是佝偻病；crickets 是蟋蟀。

examples.dst: 肥胖在儿童中日益成为问题。

examples.dst: 快餐可能导致肥胖。

examples.dst: 运动有助于预防肥胖。

confuse.diff: obesity 是名词；obese 是形容词，意为肥胖的。

examples.src: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
examples.dst: 橙子富含维生素 C。

examples.src: Children need enough vitamins to grow.
examples.dst: 孩子需要足够的维生素来成长。

examples.dst: 她每天服用维生素片。

examples.dst: 鸡蛋是蛋白质的良好来源。

examples.dst: 我们的身体需要蛋白质来增长肌肉。

examples.dst: 豆类富含蛋白质。

examples.src: He earns his living as a driver.
examples.dst: 他靠开车谋生。

examples.dst: 她靠教英语谋生。

examples.dst: 在这个镇上谋生很不容易。

confuse.diff: 两者意思相同，earn one's living 更偏书面。

examples.dst: 他还清了所有债务。

examples.src: Many students leave university with large debts.
examples.dst: 许多学生毕业时背着大笔债务。

examples.src: I owe you a debt of thanks.
examples.dst: 我欠你一份感谢。

confuse.diff: debt 是债务；doubt 是怀疑。

examples.dst: 他负债累累。

examples.dst: 这家公司欠银行的钱。

examples.src: She got into debt after buying the house.
examples.dst: 她买房后欠了债。

confuse.diff: in debt 是欠债；out of debt 是还清债务。

examples.dst: 她愤怒地瞪着他。

examples.src: The glare of the sun hurt my eyes.
examples.dst: 阳光的强光刺痛了我的眼睛。

examples.src: The two men glared at each other.
examples.dst: 两个男人怒目而视。

confuse.diff: glare 是怒视；glance 是匆匆一瞥。

examples.dst: 间谍把秘密情报发回国内。

examples.src: He spied a ship on the horizon.
examples.dst: 他发现地平线上有一艘船。

examples.src: She watched a film about a spy.
examples.dst: 她看了一部关于间谍的电影。

confuse.diff: spy 是间谍；spray 是喷洒。

examples.dst: 他因窥探邻居被抓住了。

examples.dst: 别偷看你姐姐的日记。

examples.dst: 这家公司暗中监视竞争对手。

confuse.diff: spy on 是暗中监视；look at 是普通地看。

examples.dst: 我们应该限制使用塑料。

examples.dst: 学无止境。

examples.dst: 礼堂的座位有限。

examples.src: His knowledge of art is limited.
examples.dst: 他对艺术的了解有限。

confuse.diff: limited 是形容词；limit 是名词或动词。

examples.dst: 我们可以从他的经验中受益。

confuse.diff: benefit 是名词或动词；beneficial 是形容词，意为有益的。

examples.dst: 她点了烤鸡胸肉。

examples.src: He put his hand on his breast.
examples.dst: 他把手放在胸前。

confuse.diff: breast 是胸部；breath 是呼吸。

examples.dst: 她在炒菜里加了大蒜。

examples.dst: 大蒜对健康有益。

examples.dst: 他长叹一声坐了下来。

confuse.diff: sigh 是叹息；sign 是标志或签名。

examples.src: Combine the flour and eggs in a bowl.
examples.dst: 把面粉和鸡蛋在碗里混合。

examples.dst: 她把工作和学习结合起来。

examples.dst: 这两家公司去年合并了。

confuse.diff: combine 是结合；compose 是组成或创作。

confuse.diff: cut down 是砍倒或减少；cut off 是切断。

examples.dst: 他很快就会好起来。

confuse.diff: before long 是不久之后；long before 是很早以前。

examples.dst: 她不想变胖。

examples.dst: 两国签署了合作协议。

examples.dst: 她用柠檬给蛋糕调味。

examples.src: She wants to become a businessman one day.

examples.dst: 有些人对贝类过敏。

examples.src: The restaurant is famous for its fresh shellfish.
examples.dst: 这家餐厅以新鲜的贝类海鲜而闻名。

confuse.diff: shellfish 指贝类、甲壳类；jellyfish 指水母。

examples.src: Frogs are amphibians that live both in water and on land.
examples.dst: 青蛙是既能生活在水中又能生活在陆地上的两栖动物。

examples.src: Many amphibians are disappearing because of pollution.
examples.dst: 由于污染，许多两栖动物正在消失。

examples.src: An amphibian lays its eggs in water.
examples.dst: 两栖动物把卵产在水里。

confuse.diff: amphibian 指两栖动物；reptile 指爬行动物。

examples.src: Snakes and lizards are reptiles.
examples.dst: 蛇和蜥蜴都是爬行动物。

examples.src: Reptiles cannot control their own body temperature.
examples.dst: 爬行动物无法调节自己的体温。

examples.src: The museum has a special room for reptiles.
examples.dst: 博物馆有一间专门展示爬行动物的展厅。

confuse.diff: reptile 指爬行动物；amphibian 指两栖动物。

examples.src: Hens lay eggs almost every day.
examples.dst: 母鸡几乎每天都下蛋。

examples.src: Sea turtles come onto the beach to lay eggs.
examples.dst: 海龟上岸到沙滩上产卵。

examples.src: Birds lay eggs in nests built high in the trees.
examples.dst: 鸟类在高高的树上搭的巢里产卵。

confuse.diff: lay eggs 指产卵，lay 是及物动词；lie 指躺或说谎。

examples.src: Dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙大约在六千六百万年前灭绝。

examples.src: Scientists found a complete dinosaur skeleton in the desert.
examples.dst: 科学家在沙漠中发现了一具完整的恐龙骨架。

examples.src: Many children are fascinated by dinosaurs.
examples.dst: 许多孩子对恐龙着迷。

examples.src: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙在数百万年前就存在了。

examples.src: Many animals cannot exist without clean water.
examples.dst: 许多动物没有清洁的水就无法生存。

examples.src: Do you think life exists on other planets?
examples.dst: 你认为其他星球上存在生命吗？

confuse.diff: exist 指存在；exit 指出口或离开。

examples.src: Whales are mammals, not fish.
examples.dst: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼。

examples.src: Mammals feed their babies with milk.
examples.dst: 哺乳动物用乳汁喂养幼崽。

examples.src: The bat is the only mammal that can truly fly.
examples.dst: 蝙蝠是唯一真正会飞的哺乳动物。

confuse.diff: mammal 指哺乳动物；marsupial 指有袋动物，是哺乳动物的一种。

examples.src: She gave birth to a healthy baby girl last week.
examples.dst: 她上周生下了一个健康的女婴。

examples.src: Whales give birth to live young instead of laying eggs.
examples.dst: 鲸直接产下幼崽，而不是下蛋。

examples.src: The invention of the Internet gave birth to many new industries.
examples.dst: 互联网的发明催生了许多新行业。

confuse.diff: give birth to 可指生育，也可指催生；give rise to 只指引起、导致。

examples.src: The road was blocked; thus we had to take another way.
examples.dst: 道路被堵住了，因此我们不得不走另一条路。

examples.src: He studied hard and thus passed the exam.
examples.dst: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。

examples.src: Hold the pen thus, and you will write more easily.
examples.dst: 这样握笔，你写字会更轻松。

confuse.diff: thus 指因此、这样；this 指这个。

examples.src: Each student spoke in his turn.
examples.dst: 每个学生按顺序轮流发言。

examples.src: She helped others, and they in their turn helped her.
examples.dst: 她帮助别人，别人也反过来帮助她。

examples.src: You will have a chance to ask questions in your turn.
examples.dst: 轮到你的时候你会有机会提问。

confuse.diff: in one’s turn 指轮到某人时；in turn 指依次、轮流。

examples.src: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give off oxygen.
examples.dst: 植物吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。

examples.src: Burning coal produces carbon dioxide and other gases.
examples.dst: 燃烧煤会产生二氧化碳和其他气体。

examples.src: Sulfur dioxide is one cause of acid rain.
examples.dst: 二氧化硫是酸雨的成因之一。

confuse.diff: dioxide 指二氧化物；monoxide 指一氧化物。

examples.src: Trees absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
examples.dst: 树木从空气中吸收二氧化碳。

examples.src: Too much carbon dioxide in the atmosphere leads to global warming.
examples.dst: 大气中二氧化碳过多会导致全球变暖。

examples.src: We breathe out carbon dioxide every time we exhale.
examples.dst: 我们每次呼气都会排出二氧化碳。

confuse.diff: carbon dioxide 是二氧化碳；carbon monoxide 是一氧化碳，有剧毒。

examples.src: Heavy snow prevented us from leaving the village.
examples.dst: 大雪使我们无法离开村子。

examples.src: Wearing a mask can prevent the disease from spreading.
examples.dst: 戴口罩可以防止疾病传播。

examples.src: Nothing can prevent him from following his dream.
examples.dst: 什么也阻止不了他追逐梦想。

confuse.diff: prevent...from 指阻止某事发生；protect...from 指保护免受伤害。

examples.src: The detective tried to solve the puzzle of the missing diamond.
examples.dst: 侦探试图解开钻石失踪之谜。

examples.src: His strange behaviour puzzled all his friends.
examples.dst: 他奇怪的行为让所有朋友都感到困惑。

examples.src: She spent the whole evening doing a jigsaw puzzle.
examples.dst: 她整个晚上都在拼拼图。

confuse.diff: puzzle 指谜题、使困惑；puddle 指水坑。

examples.src: We dissected a frog in our biology class.
examples.dst: 我们在生物课上解剖了一只青蛙。

examples.src: She is going to study biology at university.
examples.dst: 她打算在大学里学习生物学。

examples.src: Biology helps us understand how living things grow.
examples.dst: 生物学帮助我们了解生物是如何生长的。

confuse.diff: biology 指生物学；geology 指地质学。

examples.src: The biologist spent ten years studying birds in the rainforest.
examples.dst: 这位生物学家花了十年时间研究雨林中的鸟类。

examples.src: Biologists warn that many species are in danger.
examples.dst: 生物学家警告说许多物种正处于危险之中。

examples.src: My uncle is a marine biologist.
examples.dst: 我叔叔是一名海洋生物学家。

confuse.diff: biologist 指生物学家；biology 指生物学这门学科。

examples.src: Gravity pulls objects toward the centre of the Earth.
examples.dst: 重力把物体拉向地球中心。

examples.src: There is less gravity on the moon than on the Earth.
examples.dst: 月球上的重力比地球上小。

examples.src: The doctor explained the gravity of his illness.
examples.dst: 医生解释了他病情的严重性。

confuse.diff: gravity 指重力；gravy 指肉汁。

examples.src: China launched a new weather satellite last year.
examples.dst: 中国去年发射了一颗新的气象卫星。

examples.src: The moon is a natural satellite of the Earth.
examples.dst: 月球是地球的天然卫星。

examples.src: Satellites help us to forecast the weather and find our way.
examples.dst: 卫星帮助我们预报天气和导航。

confuse.diff: satellite 指围绕行星运转的卫星；planet 指行星。

examples.src: The nurse has a gentle voice that calms the patients.
examples.dst: 这位护士声音轻柔，能使病人平静下来。

examples.src: A gentle breeze blew across the lake.
examples.dst: 一阵微风吹过湖面。

examples.src: Be gentle with the baby; she is sleeping.
examples.dst: 对宝宝动作轻一点，她在睡觉。

confuse.diff: gentle 指温柔的；gender 指性别。

examples.src: The geologist examined the rocks to find out their age.
examples.dst: 地质学家检查岩石以确定它们的年代。

examples.src: Geologists predict that an earthquake may happen in this area.
examples.dst: 地质学家预测这个地区可能发生地震。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a geologist and exploring mountains.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名地质学家，去探索山脉。

confuse.diff: geologist 研究地质、岩石；geographer 研究地理。

examples.src: Einstein was one of the greatest physicists in history.
examples.dst: 爱因斯坦是历史上最伟大的物理学家之一。

examples.src: The physicist explained how light travels through space.
examples.dst: 物理学家解释了光如何在太空中传播。

examples.src: Many young people want to become physicists.
examples.dst: 许多年轻人想成为物理学家。

confuse.diff: physicist 指物理学家；physician 指内科医生。

examples.src: Thick curtains block out the light from the street.
examples.dst: 厚窗帘挡住了街上的光线。

examples.src: He put on headphones to block out the noise.
examples.dst: 他戴上耳机来隔绝噪音。

examples.src: She tried to block out the memory of the accident.
examples.dst: 她试图不去想那次事故的记忆。

confuse.diff: block out 指遮挡；black out 指昏倒或灯火熄灭。

examples.src: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙在数百万年前灭绝了。

examples.src: Many species will become extinct if we destroy their habitats.
examples.dst: 如果我们破坏它们的栖息地，许多物种将会灭绝。

examples.src: This is an extinct volcano that has not erupted for centuries.
examples.dst: 这是一座几个世纪都没有喷发过的死火山。

confuse.diff: extinct 指灭绝的；distinct 指明显的、不同的。

examples.src: The climate in southern China is warm and wet.
examples.dst: 中国南方的气候温暖湿润。

examples.src: Climate change is affecting farming around the world.
examples.dst: 气候变化正在影响世界各地的农业。

examples.src: The political climate in the country has changed greatly.
examples.dst: 这个国家的政治气氛已发生很大变化。

confuse.diff: climate 指长期的气候；weather 指短期的天气。

examples.src: Halley's Comet appears every seventy-six years.
examples.dst: 哈雷彗星每七十六年出现一次。

examples.src: We stayed up late to watch the comet pass across the sky.
examples.dst: 我们熬夜观看彗星划过天空。

examples.src: A comet has a bright tail made of dust and gas.
examples.dst: 彗星有一条由尘埃和气体组成的明亮尾巴。

confuse.diff: comet 指彗星；meteor 指流星。

examples.src: The plane crashed into the mountain in thick fog.
examples.dst: 飞机在浓雾中撞上了山。

examples.src: Two people were hurt in the car crash.
examples.dst: 两人在这次车祸中受伤。

examples.src: My computer crashed just before I saved the file.
examples.dst: 我保存文件之前电脑突然崩溃了。

confuse.diff: crash 指撞击、坠毁；crush 指压碎。

examples.src: The spaceship will land on Mars in two years.
examples.dst: 这艘宇宙飞船将在两年后降落火星。

examples.src: Astronauts are trained for months before flying in a spaceship.
examples.dst: 宇航员在乘坐飞船之前要训练好几个月。

examples.src: The boy dreams of travelling in a spaceship to other planets.
examples.dst: 这个男孩梦想乘坐飞船前往其他星球。

confuse.diff: spaceship 指宇宙飞船；airship 指飞艇。

examples.src: He pulled the heavy box across the floor.
examples.dst: 他把沉重的箱子拖过地板。

examples.src: The Moon's gravity pulls the sea and causes tides.
examples.dst: 月球的引力牵引海水，形成潮汐。

examples.src: The famous singer pulled a large crowd to the concert.
examples.dst: 这位著名歌手吸引了大批观众来听演唱会。

confuse.diff: pull 指拉；pool 指水池。

examples.src: Taking medicine will lessen the pain.
examples.dst: 吃药会减轻疼痛。

examples.src: New roads have lessened the traffic in the city centre.
examples.dst: 新修的道路减轻了市中心的交通压力。

examples.src: Exercise can lessen the risk of heart disease.
examples.dst: 锻炼可以降低患心脏病的风险。

confuse.diff: lessen 指减少；lesson 指课程、教训。

examples.src: Cheer up! Things will get better soon.
examples.dst: 振作起来！情况很快就会好转的。

examples.src: A phone call from her friend cheered her up.
examples.dst: 朋友的一个电话让她高兴起来。

examples.src: We bought flowers to cheer up the sick boy.
examples.dst: 我们买了花来使那个生病的男孩高兴起来。

confuse.diff: cheer up 指使高兴；cheer on 指为……加油助威。

examples.src: A paper boat floated down the stream.
examples.dst: 一只纸船顺着小溪漂下去。

examples.src: Wood floats on water, but stones sink.
examples.dst: 木头能浮在水面，而石头会下沉。

examples.src: White clouds floated slowly across the blue sky.
examples.dst: 白云缓缓飘过蓝天。

confuse.diff: float 指漂浮；flood 指洪水、淹没。

examples.src: The astronaut floated weightlessly inside the space station.
examples.dst: 宇航员在空间站里失重地漂浮着。

examples.src: Water drops drift weightlessly in space.
examples.dst: 水滴在太空中失重漂浮。

examples.src: She felt as if she were moving weightlessly through the water.
examples.dst: 她感觉自己好像在水中毫无重量地移动。

confuse.diff: weightlessly 是副词；weightless 是形容词，指失重的。

examples.src: The passengers returned to their cabins to rest.
examples.dst: 乘客们回到各自的船舱休息。

examples.src: We spent the weekend in a log cabin by the lake.
examples.dst: 我们在湖边的一间小木屋里度过了周末。

examples.src: The flight attendant walked through the cabin to check seat belts.
examples.dst: 空乘人员走过机舱检查安全带。

confuse.diff: cabin 指船舱、小屋；cabinet 指柜子或内阁。

examples.src: The mass of an object stays the same on the Moon and on Earth.
examples.dst: 物体的质量在月球和地球上是一样的。

examples.src: A mass of dark clouds gathered over the city.
examples.dst: 一大片乌云聚集在城市上空。

examples.src: Mass media play an important role in modern society.
examples.dst: 大众传媒在现代社会中起着重要作用。

confuse.diff: mass 指质量、大量；mess 指混乱。

examples.src: Now that you are here, let's begin the meeting.
examples.dst: 既然你来了，我们就开会吧。

examples.src: Now that the exams are over, we can relax.
examples.dst: 既然考试结束了，我们可以放松一下了。

examples.src: Now that he has grown up, he should take more responsibility.
examples.dst: 既然他已经长大了，就应该承担更多责任。

confuse.diff: now that 表示既然；so that 表示以便、因此。

examples.src: It took me a week to get the hang of the new software.
examples.dst: 我花了一周时间才摸清这个新软件的用法。

examples.src: Don't worry, you will soon get the hang of riding a bike.
examples.dst: 别担心，你很快就会掌握骑自行车的窍门。

examples.src: He has finally got the hang of solving these maths problems.
examples.dst: 他终于掌握了解这类数学题的诀窍。

confuse.diff: get the hang of 指掌握窍门；hang out 指闲逛、常去某处。

examples.src: The Second World War broke out in 1939.
examples.dst: 第二次世界大战于1939年爆发。

examples.src: A fire broke out in the building last night.
examples.dst: 昨晚这栋楼里发生了火灾。

examples.src: Two prisoners broke out of the jail yesterday.
examples.dst: 昨天有两名囚犯越狱了。

confuse.diff: break out 指爆发；break down 指出故障、崩溃。

examples.src: The long climb exhausted all of us.
examples.dst: 这次长途攀登使我们个个筋疲力尽。

examples.src: We will exhaust our supply of water in two days.
examples.dst: 我们的水再过两天就会用完。

examples.src: Car exhaust is a major source of air pollution.
examples.dst: 汽车尾气是空气污染的主要来源。

confuse.diff: exhaust 指耗尽；exhaustive 指详尽的、全面的。

examples.src: Watch out! There is a car coming.
examples.dst: 当心！有车来了。

examples.src: You should watch out for pickpockets in crowded places.
examples.dst: 在人多的地方要提防扒手。

examples.src: Watch out for the wet floor.
examples.dst: 小心地面湿滑。

confuse.diff: watch out 指当心；watch over 指看护、照看。

means: 多元文化的；多种文化的

examples.src: Canada is a multicultural country with people from all over the world.
examples.dst: 加拿大是一个有着来自世界各地的人民的多元文化国家。

examples.src: Our school has a multicultural community of students.
examples.dst: 我们学校的学生来自多元文化背景。

examples.src: Living in a multicultural city helps you understand different customs.
examples.dst: 生活在多元文化的城市有助于你了解不同的习俗。

confuse.diff: multicultural 指多元文化的；multinational 指跨国的、多国的。

examples.src: We have a short quiz on vocabulary every Friday.
examples.dst: 我们每周五有一次词汇小测验。

examples.src: She won first prize in the science quiz.
examples.dst: 她在科学知识竞赛中获得一等奖。

examples.src: The teacher quizzed us on the history lesson.
examples.dst: 老师就历史课内容对我们进行了提问。

confuse.diff: quiz 指测验；quit 指退出、放弃。

examples.src: Ottawa is the capital of Canada.
examples.dst: 渥太华是加拿大的首都。

examples.src: Many tourists go to Ottawa to see the tulip festival.
examples.dst: 许多游客前往渥太华观赏郁金香节。

examples.src: Ottawa lies on the Ottawa River in the province of Ontario.
examples.dst: 渥太华位于安大略省的渥太华河畔。

confuse.diff: Ottawa 是加拿大首都；Toronto 是加拿大最大的城市，但不是首都。

examples.src: The beaver is an animal that builds dams across rivers.
examples.dst: 海狸是一种会在河上筑坝的动物。

examples.src: The beaver is a national symbol of Canada.
examples.dst: 海狸是加拿大的国家象征之一。

examples.src: Beavers cut down trees with their strong front teeth.
examples.dst: 海狸用强壮的门牙咬倒树木。

confuse.diff: beaver 指海狸，有宽大扁平的尾巴；otter 指水獭，尾巴细长。

examples.src: A grizzly bear can run faster than a human.
examples.dst: 灰熊跑得比人快。

examples.src: Hikers in the mountains were warned about grizzlies.
examples.dst: 山里的徒步者被警告要提防灰熊。

examples.src: The grizzly caught a salmon in the river.
examples.dst: 灰熊在河里抓到了一条鲑鱼。

confuse.diff: grizzly 指灰熊，生活在陆地森林；polar bear 指北极熊。

examples.src: Polar bears live in the Arctic region.
examples.dst: 北极熊生活在北极地区。

examples.src: The polar ice is melting because of global warming.
examples.dst: 由于全球变暖，极地冰川正在融化。

examples.src: The two leaders hold polar views on the issue.
examples.dst: 两位领导人对这个问题持截然相反的观点。

confuse.diff: polar 是形容词，指极地的；pole 是名词，指极、杆子。

examples.src: Penguins live mainly in the Southern Hemisphere.
examples.dst: 企鹅主要生活在南半球。

examples.src: The penguin cannot fly, but it swims very well.
examples.dst: 企鹅不会飞，但游泳很棒。

examples.src: We saw a group of penguins walking on the ice in the film.
examples.dst: 我们在电影里看到一群企鹅在冰面上行走。

confuse.diff: penguin 指企鹅；pelican 指鹈鹕。

examples.src: Our prime concern is the safety of the students.
examples.dst: 我们首要关心的是学生的安全。

examples.src: The Prime Minister gave a speech about the economy.
examples.dst: 总理就经济问题发表了讲话。

examples.src: Seven is a prime number because it can only be divided by one and itself.
examples.dst: 七是质数，因为它只能被一和它本身整除。

confuse.diff: prime 指首要的、质数的；prize 指奖品。

examples.src: The foreign minister met with his Japanese counterpart yesterday.
examples.dst: 外交部长昨天会见了他的日本同行。

examples.src: The minister of education announced a new plan for schools.
examples.dst: 教育部长宣布了一项新的学校计划。

examples.src: The minister preached a sermon at the church on Sunday.
examples.dst: 牧师星期天在教堂布道。

confuse.diff: minister 指部长；ministry 指政府的部门。

examples.src: The Prime Minister of Canada visited our city last week.
examples.dst: 加拿大总理上周访问了我们这座城市。

examples.src: The prime minister promised to improve public health care.
examples.dst: 首相承诺改善公共医疗服务。

examples.src: Britain has a prime minister and a king or queen.
examples.dst: 英国既有首相，也有国王或女王。

confuse.diff: prime minister 是政府首脑，即首相；president 是总统或会长。

examples.src: The governor of the state gave a speech to students.
examples.dst: 州长向学生们发表了讲话。

examples.src: The new governor promised to build more schools.
examples.dst: 新任省长承诺要多建学校。

examples.src: The governor visited the flood area by helicopter.
examples.dst: 州长乘直升机视察了洪灾地区。

confuse.diff: governor 指州长、总督；government 指政府。

examples.src: I would like to walk rather than take the bus.
examples.dst: 我宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。

examples.src: He decided to stay at home rather than go out in the rain.
examples.dst: 他决定待在家里，而不是冒雨出去。

examples.src: The school should teach students how to think rather than what to think.
examples.dst: 学校应该教学生如何思考，而不是思考什么。

confuse.diff: rather than 表示而不是；other than 表示除了。

examples.src: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
examples.dst: 亚洲是世界上最大的洲。

examples.src: There are seven continents on the Earth.
examples.dst: 地球上有七大洲。

examples.src: Antarctica is the coldest continent and has no permanent residents.
examples.dst: 南极洲是最冷的大陆，没有永久居民。

confuse.diff: continent 指大陆；content 指内容或满足的。

examples.src: Please check your baggage at the airport counter.
examples.dst: 请在机场柜台办理行李托运。

examples.src: Each passenger is allowed twenty kilograms of baggage.
examples.dst: 每位乘客可携带二十公斤行李。

examples.src: We waited for our baggage at the carousel for half an hour.
examples.dst: 我们在行李传送带旁等了半小时才拿到行李。

confuse.diff: baggage 指旅行行李；package 指包裹。

examples.src: We chatted for hours about our plans for the summer.
examples.dst: 我们聊了好几个小时暑假的计划。

examples.src: I had a long chat with my grandmother on the phone.
examples.dst: 我和奶奶打了很长时间的电话。

examples.src: Students often chat online with friends after school.
examples.dst: 学生们放学后常常和朋友网上聊天。

confuse.diff: chat 指聊天；chart 指图表。

examples.src: The scenery along the Yangtze River is breathtaking.
examples.dst: 长江沿岸的风景美得令人屏息。

examples.src: We stopped the car to enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery.
examples.dst: 我们停下车来欣赏美丽的山景。

examples.src: The scenery for the school play was painted by students.
examples.dst: 学校话剧的布景是学生们画的。

confuse.diff: scenery 指整体风景，不可数；scene 指场景、一幕，可数。

examples.src: The train travels eastward from Chengdu to Shanghai.
examples.dst: 这列火车从成都向东开往上海。

examples.src: We headed eastward along the coast.
examples.dst: 我们沿着海岸向东行进。

examples.src: The eastward journey took us three days.
examples.dst: 向东的旅程花了我们三天时间。

confuse.diff: eastward 指向东；eastern 指东方的、东部的。

examples.src: The pioneers moved westward in search of new land.
examples.dst: 拓荒者们为了寻找新的土地向西迁移。

examples.src: The ship sailed westward across the Atlantic.
examples.dst: 这艘船向西横渡大西洋。

examples.src: The sun sets in a westward direction.
examples.dst: 太阳向西方落下。

confuse.diff: westward 指向西；western 指西方的、西部的。

examples.src: The smoke rose slowly upward into the sky.
examples.dst: 烟雾缓缓向上升入天空。

examples.src: Prices have been moving upward since the beginning of the year.
examples.dst: 年初以来物价一直在上涨。

examples.src: She cast an upward glance at the tall tower.
examples.dst: 她抬头望了一眼那座高塔。

confuse.diff: upward 与 upwards 意思相同，upward 美式更常用，upwards 英式更常用。

examples.src: High mountains surround the little village.
examples.dst: 高山环绕着这个小村庄。

examples.src: The police surrounded the building and waited.
examples.dst: 警察包围了这栋楼并等待着。

examples.src: Children should be surrounded by love and care.
examples.dst: 孩子们应该在关爱中成长。

confuse.diff: surround 指包围；surrender 指投降。

means: 落基山脉（北美洲西部的大山脉）

examples.src: The Rocky Mountains stretch from Canada down to the United States.
examples.dst: 落基山脉从加拿大一直延伸到美国。

examples.src: We went skiing in the Rocky Mountains last winter.
examples.dst: 去年冬天我们去落基山脉滑雪。

examples.src: Many wild animals such as bears and eagles live in the Rocky Mountains.
examples.dst: 熊和鹰等许多野生动物生活在落基山脉。

confuse.diff: the Rocky Mountains 位于北美洲；the Alps 位于欧洲。

examples.src: Many fishing boats were anchored in the harbour.
examples.dst: 许多渔船停泊在港湾里。

examples.src: The ship slowly sailed out of the harbour at dawn.
examples.dst: 黎明时，船缓缓驶出港口。

examples.src: He harboured a secret hope of becoming a pilot.
examples.dst: 他心里暗藏着当飞行员的愿望。

confuse.diff: harbour 指港口；harvest 指收获。

examples.src: Please measure the length of the desk with a ruler.
examples.dst: 请用尺子量一下书桌的长度。

examples.src: The government took strong measures to protect the environment.
examples.dst: 政府采取了有力措施保护环境。

examples.src: Success cannot be measured by money alone.
examples.dst: 成功不能仅用金钱来衡量。

confuse.diff: measure 是动词或名词，指测量、措施；measurement 指测量的结果或尺寸。

examples.src: All passengers went aboard the ship before noon.
examples.dst: 所有乘客在中午之前都上了船。

examples.src: Welcome aboard Flight 208 to Toronto.
examples.dst: 欢迎乘坐飞往多伦多的208次航班。

examples.src: There were over three hundred people aboard the train.
examples.dst: 火车上有三百多人。

confuse.diff: aboard 指在船、飞机上；abroad 指在国外。

examples.src: After years of travelling, he decided to settle down in his hometown.
examples.dst: 多年漂泊之后，他决定在家乡定居下来。

examples.src: Please settle down and open your books.
examples.dst: 请安静下来，翻开课本。

examples.src: It took me a few weeks to settle down in the new school.
examples.dst: 我花了几周时间才适应新学校。

confuse.diff: settle down 指安顿、安定；sit down 只指坐下。

examples.src: She managed to finish the report before the deadline.
examples.dst: 她设法在截止日期前完成了报告。

examples.src: Although it was snowing, we managed to arrive on time.
examples.dst: 虽然在下雪，我们还是设法按时到达了。

examples.src: Can you manage to carry all these books by yourself?
examples.dst: 你能一个人把这些书都拿动吗？

confuse.diff: manage to do 强调成功做到；try to do 只表示尝试，不一定成功。

examples.src: We caught sight of a deer running through the woods.
examples.dst: 我们瞥见一只鹿穿过树林跑过去。

examples.src: As soon as she caught sight of her mother, she ran towards her.
examples.dst: 她一看到妈妈就跑了过去。

examples.src: He caught sight of his old friend in the crowd.
examples.dst: 他在人群中看见了老朋友。

confuse.diff: catch sight of 指看见；lose sight of 指看不见、忽视。

examples.src: An eagle flew high above the mountains.
examples.dst: 一只鹰在群山上空高高飞翔。

examples.src: The bald eagle is a national symbol of the United States.
examples.dst: 白头海雕是美国的国家象征。

examples.src: Eagles have very sharp eyes and can see small animals from far away.
examples.dst: 鹰的眼睛非常锐利，能从远处看见小动物。

confuse.diff: eagle 指体型较大的鹰、雕；hawk 指体型较小的鹰。

examples.src: The loud noise caused the cattle to stampede.
examples.dst: 巨大的响声使牛群四处惊逃。

examples.src: Fans stampeded towards the stage when the singer appeared.
examples.dst: 歌手一出现，粉丝们便蜂拥冲向舞台。

examples.src: Several people were hurt in the stampede at the stadium.
examples.dst: 体育场内的拥挤踩踏使几人受伤。

confuse.diff: stampede 指惊逃、踩踏；stamp 指邮票、跺脚。

examples.src: The cowboy rode his horse across the wide prairie.
examples.dst: 牛仔骑着马穿过辽阔的草原。

examples.src: Cowboys used to herd cattle over long distances in the American West.
examples.dst: 牛仔过去在美国西部长途驱赶牛群。

examples.src: He wore a cowboy hat and boots to the party.
examples.dst: 他戴着牛仔帽、穿着牛仔靴去参加聚会。

confuse.diff: cowboy 指美国西部的牛仔；cowherd 指牧牛人。

examples.src: She has a gift for music and plays three instruments.
examples.dst: 她有音乐天赋，会演奏三种乐器。

examples.src: My brother has a gift for learning languages.
examples.dst: 我哥哥有学习语言的天赋。

examples.src: Some people have a gift for making others feel at ease.
examples.dst: 有些人天生就能让别人感到自在。

confuse.diff: have a gift for 后接领域；have a gift of 后接具体才能，如 the gift of gab。

examples.src: The hospital is within walking distance of my home.
examples.dst: 医院离我家步行可达。

examples.src: Please finish the task within two hours.
examples.dst: 请在两小时内完成这项任务。

examples.src: Peace comes from within.
examples.dst: 平静来自内心。

confuse.diff: within 指在……之内；without 指没有。

examples.src: The river forms the border between the two countries.
examples.dst: 这条河构成了两国的边界。

examples.src: Canada borders the United States to the south.
examples.dst: 加拿大南面与美国接壤。

examples.src: Soldiers guard the border day and night.
examples.dst: 士兵们日夜守卫着边境。

confuse.diff: border 指边界；order 指顺序、命令。

examples.src: There was a slight change in the weather this morning.
examples.dst: 今天早晨天气有轻微变化。

examples.src: I have a slight headache, but it is nothing serious.
examples.dst: 我有点头疼，但不严重。

examples.src: Not the slightest hint of fear showed on his face.
examples.dst: 他脸上丝毫没有显出恐惧。

confuse.diff: slight 指轻微的；light 指光线、轻的。

examples.src: The price has gone up slightly this month.
examples.dst: 这个月价格略有上涨。

examples.src: She felt slightly nervous before the speech.
examples.dst: 演讲之前，她感到有点紧张。

examples.src: Please move slightly to the left.
examples.dst: 请稍微向左移一点。

confuse.diff: slightly 是副词，指略微地；slightest 是形容词最高级，指最轻微的。

examples.src: The farmer owns fifty acres of land.
examples.dst: 这位农民拥有五十英亩土地。

examples.src: The park covers an area of over two hundred acres.
examples.dst: 这座公园占地两百多英亩。

examples.src: An acre is about four thousand square metres.
examples.dst: 一英亩约合四千平方米。

confuse.diff: acre 是英亩；hectare 是公顷，约为 2.47 英亩。

examples.src: More and more people are moving to urban areas to find jobs.
examples.dst: 越来越多的人搬到城市地区找工作。

examples.src: Urban traffic is a serious problem in big cities.
examples.dst: 城市交通是大城市的一个严重问题。

examples.src: Urban life is usually faster than life in the countryside.
examples.dst: 城市生活通常比乡村生活节奏更快。

confuse.diff: urban 指城市的；urbane 指文雅的、彬彬有礼的。

examples.src: The hotel is in a perfect location near the beach.
examples.dst: 这家旅馆位置绝佳，靠近海滩。

examples.src: Please tell me the exact location of the accident.
examples.dst: 请告诉我事故发生的确切地点。

examples.src: The film was shot on location in the Rocky Mountains.
examples.dst: 这部电影在落基山脉实地拍摄。

confuse.diff: location 指位置；vocation 指职业、使命。

examples.src: The Vatican City State is the smallest country in the world.
examples.dst: 梵蒂冈城国是世界上最小的国家。

examples.src: The Vatican City State lies inside the city of Rome.
examples.dst: 梵蒂冈城国位于罗马城内。

examples.src: The Pope lives in the Vatican City State.
examples.dst: 教皇居住在梵蒂冈城国。

confuse.diff: the Vatican City State 是世界最小的国家；Monaco 是摩纳哥，是第二小的国家。

examples.src: The topic of today's discussion is how to protect the environment.
examples.dst: 今天讨论的话题是如何保护环境。

examples.src: Choose a topic that interests you for your essay.
examples.dst: 为你的作文选一个你感兴趣的题目。

examples.src: Politics is not a good topic to talk about at dinner.
examples.dst: 政治不是适合在饭桌上谈论的话题。

confuse.diff: topic 指话题；tropic 指热带、回归线。

examples.src: Mix the flour and eggs together in a large bowl.
examples.dst: 把面粉和鸡蛋放在大碗里搅拌在一起。

examples.src: Oil and water do not mix.
examples.dst: 油和水不相融。

examples.src: She finds it easy to mix with people from different cultures.
examples.dst: 她觉得和不同文化背景的人相处很容易。

confuse.diff: mix 指混合；mess 指混乱。

examples.src: Air is a mixture of several gases.
examples.dst: 空气是多种气体的混合物。

examples.src: He looked at the result with a mixture of surprise and joy.
examples.dst: 他带着惊讶和喜悦交织的心情看着结果。

examples.src: Stir the mixture slowly over low heat.
examples.dst: 用小火慢慢搅拌这混合物。

confuse.diff: mixture 是名词，指混合物；mix 通常是动词，指混合。

examples.src: A rabbit ran out from behind the bush.
examples.dst: 一只兔子从灌木丛后面跑出来。

examples.src: Roses grow on thorny bushes.
examples.dst: 玫瑰长在多刺的灌木上。

examples.src: They went on a walk through the Australian bush.
examples.dst: 他们在澳大利亚的荒野里徒步。

confuse.diff: bush 指灌木；brush 指刷子。

examples.src: The maple leaf is the national symbol of Canada.
examples.dst: 枫叶是加拿大的国家象征。

examples.src: Maple trees turn red in autumn and attract many tourists.
examples.dst: 枫树在秋天变红，吸引了许多游客。

examples.src: We poured maple syrup on our pancakes.
examples.dst: 我们在薄煎饼上淋了枫糖浆。

confuse.diff: maple 指枫树；mango 指芒果。

examples.src: The grass was white with frost this morning.
examples.dst: 今早草地上结满了白霜。

examples.src: An early frost damaged the crops in the north.
examples.dst: 一场早霜损害了北方的庄稼。

examples.src: The window was frosted over on the cold winter night.
examples.dst: 寒冷的冬夜里，窗户上结了一层霜花。

confuse.diff: frost 指霜；forest 指森林。

examples.src: Please confirm your flight reservation by phone.
examples.dst: 请通过电话确认你的机票预订。

examples.src: The test results confirmed that the water was safe to drink.
examples.dst: 检测结果证实这水可以安全饮用。

examples.src: The company has not yet confirmed the date of the meeting.
examples.dst: 公司尚未确认会议的日期。

confuse.diff: confirm 指确认；conform 指遵守、符合。

examples.src: He came from a wealthy family and never worried about money.
examples.dst: 他出身富裕的家庭，从不为钱发愁。

examples.src: The wealthy businessman donated a large sum to the school.
examples.dst: 这位富有的商人向学校捐了一大笔钱。

examples.src: Switzerland is one of the wealthiest countries in the world.
examples.dst: 瑞士是世界上最富有的国家之一。

confuse.diff: wealthy 指富有的；healthy 指健康的。

examples.src: The distance between the two cities is about 300 kilometres.
examples.dst: 两座城市之间的距离大约是三百公里。

examples.src: She runs long distances every morning to keep fit.
examples.dst: 她每天早晨长跑来保持健康。

examples.src: I could see the mountains in the distance.
examples.dst: 我能看到远处的群山。

confuse.diff: distance 是名词，指距离；distant 是形容词，指遥远的。

examples.src: We saw a small light in the distance.
examples.dst: 我们看见远处有一点小小的光亮。

examples.src: The sound of thunder was heard in the distance.
examples.dst: 远处传来了雷声。

examples.src: A tall tower stood in the distance.
examples.dst: 远处矗立着一座高塔。

confuse.diff: in the distance 指在远处看得见；at a distance 指保持一定距离。

examples.src: A thin mist covered the valley this morning.
examples.dst: 今早一层薄雾笼罩着山谷。

examples.src: The mountains disappeared into the mist.
examples.dst: 群山消失在薄雾之中。

examples.src: Her glasses misted up when she entered the warm room.
examples.dst: 她走进暖和的房间时，眼镜上蒙了一层水汽。

confuse.diff: mist 指较薄的雾；fog 指较浓的雾，能见度更低。

examples.src: It was a cold and misty morning by the lake.
examples.dst: 湖边是一个寒冷而有薄雾的早晨。

examples.src: The misty mountains looked like a painting.
examples.dst: 云雾缭绕的群山看起来像一幅画。

examples.src: Her eyes grew misty when she heard the sad song.
examples.dst: 听到那首悲伤的歌，她的眼睛模糊了。

confuse.diff: misty 指有雾的；mystery 指谜、神秘。

examples.src: I met an old schoolmate on the train yesterday.
examples.dst: 我昨天在火车上碰到了一位老同学。

examples.src: Her schoolmates organized a party for her birthday.
examples.dst: 她的同学们为她的生日办了一场聚会。

examples.src: He still keeps in touch with his schoolmates after graduation.
examples.dst: 毕业之后，他仍和同学们保持联系。

confuse.diff: schoolmate 指同校的同学；classmate 指同班同学。

examples.src: She bought a ticket at the ticket booth.
examples.dst: 她在售票亭买了一张票。

examples.src: Many companies have set up booths at the book fair.
examples.dst: 许多公司在书展上设了摊位。

examples.src: He stepped into the phone booth to make a call.
examples.dst: 他走进电话亭打电话。

confuse.diff: booth 指售货亭、隔间；boot 指靴子。

examples.src: We took a bus downtown to go shopping.
examples.dst: 我们乘公共汽车去市中心购物。

examples.src: She works in a downtown office near the station.
examples.dst: 她在车站附近的市中心办公室工作。

examples.src: Downtown is always crowded on weekends.
examples.dst: 周末市中心总是人满为患。

confuse.diff: downtown 指市中心；downturn 指经济下滑。

examples.src: She wore a necklace made of white pearls.
examples.dst: 她戴着一条白色珍珠项链。

examples.src: Pearls are formed inside oysters.
examples.dst: 珍珠是在牡蛎体内形成的。

examples.src: Hong Kong was once called the Pearl of the Orient.
examples.dst: 香港曾被称为东方之珠。

confuse.diff: pearl 指珍珠；peach 指桃子。

examples.src: The journey takes approximately two hours by train.
examples.dst: 乘火车的旅程大约需要两个小时。

examples.src: Approximately 500 students attended the lecture.
examples.dst: 大约有五百名学生听了这场讲座。

examples.src: The lake is approximately three kilometres long.
examples.dst: 这个湖大约有三公里长。

confuse.diff: approximately 指大约；appropriately 指适当地。

examples.src: We got up at dawn to watch the sun rise over the sea.
examples.dst: 我们黎明时起床，观看海上日出。

examples.src: The dawn of the Internet age changed the way we live.
examples.dst: 互联网时代的到来改变了我们的生活方式。

examples.src: It suddenly dawned on me that I had left my wallet at home.
examples.dst: 我突然意识到自己把钱包落在家里了。

confuse.diff: dawn 指黎明；down 指向下。

examples.src: Safety is the first rule in any workplace.
examples.dst: 安全是任何工作场所的首要规则。

examples.src: More women are now entering the workplace than before.
examples.dst: 现在进入职场的女性比以前更多。

examples.src: A friendly workplace helps employees work more happily.
examples.dst: 友好的工作环境使员工工作更愉快。

confuse.diff: workplace 指工作场所；workshop 指车间或研讨会。

examples.src: The hotel serves a big breakfast buffet every morning.
examples.dst: 这家酒店每天早晨供应丰盛的自助早餐。

examples.src: We had a buffet dinner at the wedding party.
examples.dst: 婚宴上我们吃的是自助晚餐。

examples.src: At a buffet, you can take as much food as you like.
examples.dst: 在自助餐厅，你可以随意取用食物。

confuse.diff: buffet 指自助餐；buffer 指缓冲器、缓冲。

examples.src: A broad river runs through the middle of the city.
examples.dst: 一条宽阔的河流从城市中间穿过。

examples.src: The school offers a broad range of courses.
examples.dst: 这所学校开设了种类广泛的课程。

examples.src: Reading widely can broaden your mind and give you a broad view of the world.
examples.dst: 广泛阅读可以开阔你的头脑，让你对世界有更宽广的视野。

confuse.diff: broad 指宽阔的；abroad 指在国外。

examples.src: We had lunch at a nearby restaurant.
examples.dst: 我们在附近的一家餐厅吃了午饭。

examples.src: Is there a bank nearby?
examples.dst: 附近有银行吗？

examples.src: Many students live nearby and walk to school.
examples.dst: 许多学生住在附近，步行上学。

confuse.diff: nearby 指在附近；nearly 指几乎。

examples.src: It is a Chinese tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
examples.dst: 除夕吃饺子是中国的传统。

examples.src: The school has a long tradition of academic excellence.
examples.dst: 这所学校有悠久的学术卓越传统。

examples.src: Young people should respect their own traditions and learn about others.
examples.dst: 年轻人应该尊重自己的传统，同时了解其他文化。

confuse.diff: tradition 是名词，指传统；traditional 是形容词，指传统的。

examples.src: The thunder terrified the little dog.
examples.dst: 雷声把小狗吓坏了。

examples.src: The idea of speaking in front of hundreds of people terrifies me.
examples.dst: 一想到要在几百人面前讲话我就害怕。

examples.src: The horror story terrified the children.
examples.dst: 这个恐怖故事吓坏了孩子们。

confuse.diff: terrify 指使恐惧；terrific 指极好的、了不起的。

examples.src: The terrified girl hid under the bed.
examples.dst: 吓坏了的女孩躲在床底下。

examples.src: I was terrified when I heard a strange noise at night.
examples.dst: 夜里听到奇怪的声音，我吓坏了。

examples.src: He is terrified of flying and always takes the train.
examples.dst: 他很怕坐飞机，总是坐火车。

confuse.diff: terrified 形容人感到恐惧；terrifying 形容事物令人恐惧。

examples.src: The teacher was pleased with our progress.
examples.dst: 老师对我们的进步感到满意。

examples.src: I am pleased to meet you.
examples.dst: 很高兴认识你。

examples.src: She looked very pleased when she heard the news.
examples.dst: 听到这个消息，她看起来非常高兴。

confuse.diff: pleased 指人感到高兴；pleasant 指事物令人愉快。

means: 给……留下深刻印象；使钦佩

examples.src: Her fluent English impressed the interviewers.
examples.dst: 她流利的英语给面试官留下了深刻印象。

examples.src: I was deeply impressed by the beauty of the old town.
examples.dst: 古镇的美景给我留下了深刻的印象。

examples.src: He tried to impress his friends by showing off his new phone.
examples.dst: 他想通过炫耀新手机来给朋友们留下好印象。

confuse.diff: impress 指使印象深刻；express 指表达。

means: 给人深刻印象的；令人钦佩的

examples.src: The students gave an impressive performance at the school concert.
examples.dst: 学生们在学校音乐会上的表演令人印象深刻。

examples.src: His knowledge of history is very impressive.
examples.dst: 他的历史知识令人钦佩。

examples.src: The new library is an impressive building with a glass roof.
examples.dst: 新图书馆是一座有着玻璃屋顶的、令人赞叹的建筑。

confuse.diff: impressive 是形容词，指令人印象深刻的；impression 是名词，指印象。
